Top pharmaceutical distributors in the UAE include [Arabian Ethicals](https://arabianethicals.ae/pharmaceuticals/), [Modern Pharmaceutical LLC (MPC Healthcare)](https://mpchealthcare.com/), [GulfDrug](https://www.gulfdrug.com/en), [AKI Pharma](https://www.akigroup.com/our-businesses/aki-healthcare/aki-pharma), and [Al Hayat Pharmaceuticals](https://alhayatuae.com/). These licensed operators manage nationwide cold-chain logistics, regulatory registrations, and institutional supply for hospitals and pharmacies.

- **Modern Pharmaceutical LLC (MPC Healthcare):** Offers long-standing market presence, regulatory support, and end-to-end supply chain solutions. [](https://mpchealthcare.com/)

- **Arabian Ethicals:** Specializes in branded and generic drugs, hospital-grade items, and animal health products with temperature-controlled storage. [](https://arabianethicals.ae/pharmaceuticals/)

- **GulfDrug:** Provides comprehensive pharmaceuticals, medical instruments, and laboratory supplies since 1969

[](https://www.gulfdrug.com/en)

- **AKI Pharma (Alphamed):** Focuses on specialty medicines, vaccines, cold-chain handling, and last-mile delivery. [](https://www.akigroup.com/our-businesses/aki-healthcare/aki-pharma)

- **Al Hayat Pharmaceuticals:** Distributes for multinational brands to major public and private healthcare sectors. [](https://alhayatuae.com/)

- **Planet Pharmacies:** Runs a widespread wholesale network supplying private clinics, health centers, and retail pharmacies. [](https://www.planetme.ae/en/contents/view/planet-distribution.html)

[](https://arabianethicals.ae/pharmaceuticals/)
